findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_booking_link" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_availability, render_availability_card, render_rates_card, get_apartment_details, render_apartment_gallery, get_offers, get_booking_link, get_region_info, render_house_photos · Private data: get_region_info · Public sink: render_apartment_gallery, get_booking_link, get_region_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_availability, render_availability_card, render_rates_card, get_apartment_details, render_apartment_gallery, get_offers, get_booking_link, get_region_info, render_house_photos · Private data: get_region_info · Public sink: render_apartment_gallery, get_booking_link, get_region_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
